worlds.name: THE GREAT START
worlds.subtitle: Urban Roadworks Zone
worlds.description: Morning sunlight across an Indian city arterial under construction. Cones, yellow road rollers, and spring barricades teach your core bounce.

worlds.name: HIGHWAY HUSTLE
worlds.subtitle: NH-BOUNCE Six-Lane Expressway
worlds.description: High-speed toll plazas, roaring Ashok-style trucks, auto-rickshaws, and asphalt speed boosters across golden afternoon tarmac.

worlds.name: BRIDGE BREAKER
worlds.subtitle: Grand River Cable-Stayed Crossing
worlds.description: Towering red steel cranes, suspended concrete girders, construction hoists, and daring spans high above the riverbed.

worlds.name: MOUNTAIN EXPRESS
worlds.subtitle: Western Ghats Switchback Corridor
worlds.description: Crisp misty mountain hairpins, carved stone retaining walls, rockfall hazards, and narrow valley viaducts.

worlds.name: THE POTHOLE KINGDOM
worlds.subtitle: Cratered Civic Bypass
worlds.description: Collapsing asphalt plates, giant repair craters outfitted with pneumatic springs, and detour barricade mazes.

worlds.name: TUNNEL TROUBLE
worlds.subtitle: Subterranean Rohtang Boreworks
worlds.description: Amber sodium-lit underground highway bores, drilling rigs, convoy trucks, and echoing ventilation shafts.

worlds.name: FLYOVER FRENZY
worlds.subtitle: Metro Multi-Tier Cloverleaf
worlds.description: Stacked elevated flyovers, sweeping spiral entry ramps, double-decker drops, and busy skyline traffic.

worlds.name: THE MONSOON MISSION
worlds.subtitle: Coastal Konkan Rainway
worlds.description: Slick rainwater puddles, pouring monsoon sheets, distant thunderclaps, and mist-veiled coastal viaducts.

worlds.name: MEGA CONSTRUCTION
worlds.subtitle: BHA Super-Corridor Foundry
worlds.description: Colossal gantry cranes, synchronized dual road rollers, gravity test bays, and heavy steel assembly lines.

worlds.name: THE ULTIMATE BOUNCEBACK
worlds.subtitle: Golden Quadrilateral Zenith
worlds.description: Every highway discipline united at dusk: collapsing mega-bridges, expressway convoys, gravity lifts, and the final triumph.
